g.title: legend
g.text: Orange: Project / Layer rule Blue: new table Grey: existing / extended Green: accepted placement
Solid: selected identity / version references. Dashed: logical history. Dotted: policy, acceptance or derivation.
Each relationship revision also has root / predecessor, Organisation scope, evidence and known dates.
Replacement keeps distinct identities; redirect is only for reviewed duplicate identity.
Consumers pin exact revisions. Public building views never grant access to private tenants or Features.
Diagram numbers match the walkthrough. This is a proposal, not an installed schema.
